dataset.name: RTOBuddy India Knowledge Base - National Baseline
dataset.source_policy: Each legal-sensitive record must resolve to a source ID present in data/common/sources.json.

rules.title: Learner licence application
rules.summary: Learner licence applications should use the prescribed process and forms and satisfy age, class and medical/fitness requirements applicable to the applicant.
rules.legal_safety_note: Educational summary. Do not treat this record as a substitute for the current Act, Rules, notification or State/UT order.

rules.title: Learner licence validity
rules.summary: A learner licence is generally effective for six months from issue, subject to the Act and applicable rules.
rules.legal_safety_note: Educational summary. Do not treat this record as a substitute for the current Act, Rules, notification or State/UT order.

rules.title: Learner driving conditions
rules.summary: A learner must comply with CMVR Rule 3 and applicable conditions, including prescribed supervision and learner display requirements.
rules.legal_safety_note: Educational summary. Do not treat this record as a substitute for the current Act, Rules, notification or State/UT order.

rules.title: Driving licence test
rules.summary: Applicants for a driving licence are required to satisfy the statutory driving test requirements for the relevant vehicle class.
rules.legal_safety_note: Educational summary. Do not treat this record as a substitute for the current Act, Rules, notification or State/UT order.

rules.title: Core licence forms
rules.summary: Parivahan provides Form 1/1A, Form 2, Form 4, Form 8 and Form 9 for specified driving-licence services.
rules.legal_safety_note: Educational summary. Do not treat this record as a substitute for the current Act, Rules, notification or State/UT order.

rules.title: Driving licence renewal
rules.summary: Renewal is handled under section 15 and applicable rules; validity and medical requirements depend on licence category and applicant circumstances.
rules.legal_safety_note: Educational summary. Do not treat this record as a substitute for the current Act, Rules, notification or State/UT order.

rules.title: Addition of vehicle class
rules.summary: A licence holder seeking an additional class should use the prescribed process and satisfy the applicable test/requirements.
rules.legal_safety_note: Educational summary. Do not treat this record as a substitute for the current Act, Rules, notification or State/UT order.

rules.title: International Driving Permit

rules.legal_safety_note: Educational summary. Do not treat this record as a substitute for the current Act, Rules, notification or State/UT order.

rules.title: Core registration forms
